newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CNB 13-WEEK BILL YIELD DIPS TO 12.2 PCT.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CNB 13-WEEK BILL YIELD DIPS TO 12.2 PCT.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) said on Thursday that gross yield in its Dutch-style auction of a five billion crown tranche of 13-week liquidity bills hit 12.20 percent.
In the last auction of similar CNB bills on March 6, gross yield was 12.4 percent.
The CNB said the issue was oversubscribed with bids totalling 10.472 billion. Bills worth 4.999 billion were sold.
Net yield was 9.15 percent, the CNB added.
The three-month Prague interbank offered rate (PRIBOR) stood at 12.42 percent on Thursday, up three basis points from Wednesday.
